blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Farmers from Sablayan, Occidental Mindoro are adjusting their cropping plans and seeking alternative irrigation sources as the country braces for a potentially prolonged El Niño that could bring water shortages to agricultural areas, according to a report from the Philippine Information Agency in MIMAROPA on Thursday. Sablayan Municipal Agriculture Officer Peter Gallenera said the local government and farmers discussed preparations during a Municipal Development Council meeting, including identifying areas that could face limited water availability.
